# LRCLIB answers

The shapes of LRCLIB's real answers (read once on 2026-11-12 from `GET /api/get` and `GET /api/search`): the same
fields, types and status bodies, with made-up songs and words in place of real ones (lyrics belong to their writers,
and the tests' data stays invented). `not-found.json` and `rate-limited.json` are LRCLIB's own bodies as it sends them.
